policy: READ-ONLY audit. Not one formula record was edited. Ting reviews this before any repair starts.

defect_score = missing_fields*2 + suspicious_fields*3. It ranks work, it does not measure clinical quality — a card can score low and still be wrong.
A validator PASS means nothing here: validate-formula-standard reports PASS on all 201 while 28 of these 30 lack 君臣佐使, tongue and pulse.
